diagnosis: The CRM deal endpoint eager-loads Deal and related primary_contact using ormar's .objects.select_related(...).get(id=deal_id) without scoping the query to current_user.workspace_id. Any authenticated sales representative can query deals from competing sales teams, exposing contract values, stage pipelines, and executive contact phone numbers.
exploit_request:
GET /crm/deals/3840 HTTP/1.1
Host: app.salescrm.io
Authorization: Bearer <sales_rep_token>
